review.images: Reviewed the seven official gallery images and the wide hero. The narrower repeated entrance scene was omitted. The lawn-side tower view supplies the card. The living room and bedroom are used for the editorial panels.
review.location: Confirmed the named project point, the regional map and all four brochure estimates on physical page 9. The brochure groups DXB and DWC in the same 20-minute item.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all 13 original Tower A drawings and 15 Emaar-branded Tower B sheets via Homeland Realty, retaining the broker markings. Read every title and imperial area table and checked all components against the published totals. The Tower B developer pack at https://investindxb.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/EMAAR-ADDRESS-DUBAI-HILLS-FLOOR-PLANS-TOWER-B-investindxb.pdf corroborates the 15-sheet scope, but the local PDF download failed its TLS handshake. The displayed originals therefore link to the credited individual sheets. Some key diagrams retain the source’s general outlook labels.

unavailable: Exact townhouse floor-plan sheets, Tower B PDF bytes and signed unit-specific measurements were not verified.
